title: Weekly release sync
tts: Kokoro-82M v1.1-zh via sherpa-onnx, voices S1=sid 0, S2=sid 62

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Morning. Let's keep this short. The main topic is the mobile release that was planned for this Friday.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Right. The build is ready, but the offline sync still loses some changes when the network comes back.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: How long do you need to fix that?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: About two days. I will fix the offline sync bug and push a new build by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay. Then we move the release from Friday to next Tuesday. Is everyone fine with that?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good, that is decided. I will update the release notes and share them with the support team by Thursday.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Could you also ask the design team for the new pictures for the app store?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sure, I will ask them today.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: One more thing. The crash rate on older phones went up last week. I would like the test team to run the full regression suite on the new build before Monday.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Agreed. Let's meet again on Monday to confirm the release.

action_items.task: Fix the offline sync bug and push a new build
Update the release notes and share them with the support team
Ask the design team for the new pictures for the app store
Run the full regression suite on the new build

decisions: The release moves from Friday to next Tuesday.
